result.description: Compact collaboration device for meeting rooms and hybrid classrooms featuring dual wide-angle cameras, beamforming microphones, integrated speaker array, and one-cable USB-C connectivity. Supports 4K video output, wireless screen sharing, room-analytics dashboards, and automatic noise suppression for video conferencing platforms. Designed for tabletop or wall-mounted deployment in small to medium spaces.
